name: ICD-11 WHO Version
description: WHO International Classification of Diseases, 11th Revision (MMS), modeled as a navigable classification hierarchy in OCL. Content is reproduced from the WHO ICD-11 MMS Simple Tabulation (release 2026-01); codes, titles, and Foundation/Linearization URIs are preserved verbatim. © WHO 2020, licensed CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. This Source adds no translations and no crosswalks to other terminologies; the only mappings are intra-source NARROWER-THAN links from each post-coordinated code to its first stem. Extra names without a name_type are WHO Foundation entity titles and synonyms kept as lexical aliases, not an asserted equivalence. The synthetic root concept ICD-11-Root, the concept_class property, the release-pinned BrowserLink, the isPostcoordinated and Foundation URL fields, and those mappings are added by this pipeline and are not WHO content; every other property is a WHO Simple Tabulation field. Citation: International Classification of Diseases, Eleventh Revision (ICD-11), World Health Organization (WHO) 2019, https://icd.who.int/browse11. properties.description: OCL concept class that distinguishes the synthetic root, chapters, blocks, and diagnosis categories. Not a WHO field: derived by this pipeline from the Simple Tabulation's ClassKind column.
ICD-11 chapter the entity belongs to, verbatim from the Simple Tabulation (WHO field; for example 01 or X). A string, because the extension chapter is not numeric.
Depth of the entity within its class kind, as defined by the Simple Tabulation readme (WHO field): a category with depth 2 has a category parent whose own parent is not a category.
True when the entity is a residual category (other specified or unspecified), verbatim from the Simple Tabulation (WHO field).
True when the entity has no children in the tabulation, verbatim from the Simple Tabulation (WHO field). Post-coordinated codes are always True (set by this pipeline: a composite has no children).
WHO Simple Tabulation block identifier associated with the entity, when supplied (WHO field).

WHO ICD-11 browser URL for the entity, reproduced verbatim from the Simple Tabulation's BrowserLink cell (WHO field, not modified). WHO writes it as a latestrelease link, so it points at the current release and is not pinned to the imported one; for entity 1095611231 the WHO value is https://icd.who.int/browse/latestrelease/mms/en#1095611231 (a pinned link for release 2026-01 would instead read .../browse/2026-01/mms/en#1095611231). For a post-coordinated code there is no WHO cell: this pipeline builds the same latestrelease-style link from the composite Linearization URIs (derived, not a WHO value).

WHO ICD-11 Foundation entity URI (http://id.who.int/icd/entity/<id>; it resolves through the WHO ICD-API only, not in a browser), supplied by the Simple Tabulation (WHO field). For a post-coordinated code it is composed by this pipeline from the same entity id used for the Foundation URL (see there).
WHO ICD-11 MMS linearization URI, supplied by the Simple Tabulation (WHO field).

True when this concept is an indexed post-coordinated code, a composite WHO code such as '1A00&XN62R' or '5B81.Y/1A00' (the id always contains '&' or '/'; no other id does). Added by the separate post-coordinated layer. Not a WHO Simple Tabulation field: derived by this pipeline from the WHO ICD-API search index.

Browser link of the Foundation entity, pinned to the imported release: https://icd.who.int/browse/<release>/foundation/en#<Foundation entity id>. Complements the Foundation URI, which only the WHO ICD-API resolves. The entity id is the one in the Foundation URI; the link is composed by this pipeline, not a WHO cell. For a post-coordinated code the entity is the composite's own Foundation entity when the WHO ICD-API reports one, otherwise the single entity the search index attaches to it; omitted (with the Foundation URI) when there are several candidates, and for the synthetic root and categories (residuals) that have no Foundation entity of their own.

filters.description: Focuses the concept list on diagnosis categories rather than the synthetic root, chapters, and blocks.
Focuses the concept list on leaf entities.
Focuses the concept list on residual categories (other specified or unspecified), as flagged by the WHO Simple Tabulation.
Focuses the concept list on indexed post-coordinated codes (ids that contain '&' or '/'; the separate add-on layer).
